additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in the current build. FHIR-28598 later repeated the MedicationKnowledge.status cleanup and already has a no-change audit on the combined branch. FHIR-32801 later made MedicationKnowledge a MetadataResource and already has a combined-branch source fix aligning status to publication-status lifecycle semantics.
